title: 实现生产 PostgreSQL 运行时与迁移就绪检查
changed_contracts: CoreServer database-mode readiness contract v01-010/1 (additive; v01-008/1 host_only remains unchanged)
risks: Database readiness remains explicit opt-in so production-database-composition stays blocked until authenticated read-host integration makes it a required dependency.
Production authentication, TLS and secret lifecycle, business APIs, migration orchestration, login provisioning and all production file writes remain unimplemented or disabled.
The real PostgreSQL 16.15 runtime evidence was executed locally on Windows; the updated Linux CI job is source-validated but was not remotely executed in this thread.
Any production migration changes the embedded manifest trust root and requires a rebuilt, revalidated release artifact.

architecture_review.module: CoreServer database runtime composition and migration readiness adapter
reused_existing_logic: V01-003 production migration manifest, bootstrap checksum, ledger and assetlibrary_database_auditor remain the only database migration truth.
V01-008 CoreServer host options, JSON, exit codes, health/readiness endpoints, lifecycle logging and release provenance are extended rather than duplicated.
The existing centrally locked Npgsql 10.0.3 dependency provides the bounded PostgreSQL data source; no new package was added.
The existing fast-merge-database CI tier receives the runtime test without a parallel tier or skip path.
cross_module_access: The Host adapter reads only migration.bootstrap_state and migration.ledger after switching to the fixed auditor role; it does not access business schemas or module Infrastructure.
No Domain/Application project gained database, filesystem, network or platform dependencies.
No product module writes another module's tables and no production file adapter is composed.
contract_changes: Adds an additive host_database readiness response with internal database contract v01-010/1; the unconfigured v01-008/1 host_only response remains byte-compatible.
Embeds the existing production migration manifest and adds its complete directory to release provenance; no SQL, manifest, shared wire contract or release gate changed.
architecture_tests: Complete .NET locked restore, format, zero-warning Release build and 197 tests passed; Packaging has 30 passing tests.
54 real PostgreSQL 16.15 database tests passed, including live host readiness, drift recovery, bounded lock timeout, disconnect and least-privilege startup rejection.
54 repository, 14 architecture and 32 release tests passed; repository verifier, source policy, manifest and release-definition validators passed.
v0.1-start remains allowed while aggregate Alpha readiness and v0.1-release remain fail-closed with all prior blockers intact.
technical_debt: Freeze and implement the production authentication model before exposing any business endpoint.
Compose authenticated read-only use cases in the shared Host and make database readiness mandatory before requesting production-database-composition closure.
Implement TLS, certificate and deployment-secret lifecycle separately; the environment variable here is only the bounded ingestion boundary.
Keep production writes and every platform release disabled until their existing evidence gates close.
